info.name: 180 Instructor Revenue & Payout API
info.description:
JSON API for the instructor revenue ledger: Sanctum Bearer tokens, subscriptions, Hamilton-Hare period allocation, append-only ledger, and two-phase payouts.

**Base URL:** Run `php artisan serve` and keep `base_url` as `http://127.0.0.1:8000` (not `/`, not `/api`, not `/api/v1` alone — those return `error_code: not_found`). Full paths look like `{{base_url}}/api/v1/auth/login`.

**Seed first (recommended):** `php artisan migrate --seed` runs Spatie roles/permissions then demo volume data. Staff logins (password `password`): `admin@example.com` (super_admin), `finance@example.com`, `ops@example.com`, plus Postman `instructor@example.com` / `student@example.com`. Filament admin: `{{base_url}}/admin` (requires `admin.access`).

**Auth:** Collection uses Bearer `{{access_token}}`. Login and register requests disable inherited auth and write `data.token` into `access_token` (and role-specific token variables).

**Authorization:** Spatie roles/permissions on every protected route (via policies). Subscription show/cancel/upgrade: owning student (or staff with matching perms). Instructor list: `instructors.view_any`. Ledger/balance: `ledger.view` + instructor visibility. Instructor payouts: `payouts.view` / `payouts.view_any` + instructor visibility. Auth payloads include `roles` and `permissions`. Guests → `401 unauthenticated`; policy denials → `403 forbidden`. Missing models → `{model}.not_found`; unknown paths → `not_found`.

**Admin UI:** Filament at `{{base_url}}/admin` — finance resources, dashboard charts, Users + Roles & permissions (not in this collection).

**Suggested run order:** Login Student (or Register) → List/Create Subscription → Show Subscription → Allocate Period (if still pending) → Ledger/Balance → Run Payout Cycle → `php artisan queue:work` → List Payouts.

Plan tiers: `monthly`, `three_month`, `annual`. Currency is always integer cents. Payout threshold is 2000 cents ($20.00).

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Register/login use request-level noauth. Get Current User and Logout inherit collection Bearer `{{access_token}}`. Successful register/login persist Sanctum tokens into collection variables.

request.description: Create an instructor account. Saves `instructor_id` and `instructor_access_token`, and sets `access_token`.

response.name: 409 Duplicate email
422 Validation failed

request.description: Create a student account. Overwrites `access_token` with the student token.
Revokes previous tokens and issues a new Sanctum token stored in `access_token` and `student_access_token`.

response.name: 401 Invalid credentials
422 Validation failed

request.description: Use when you need instructor-scoped calls. Sets `access_token` to the instructor token.
Returns the user bound to the collection Bearer token. Does not include the token.
Revokes the current access token. Run last; subsequent inherited-auth requests will 401 until you log in again.

item.name: Subscriptions
item.description: Student purchase, amortization schedule, cancel, and mid-term upgrade (senior bonus).

request.description: Books deferred revenue and creates 1 period. Saves `subscription_id` and first `period_id`.

response.name: 422 Validation failed

request.description: Creates 3 equal recognition periods.
Creates 12 equal recognition periods.
Includes amortization `periods` used as `period_id` for allocation. Ownership is enforced — use the student token that created the subscription.
Prorates consumed days, voids remaining periods, creates a new subscription. Optional consumption_weights allocate the consumed window immediately.

response.name: 422 Not upgradeable
422 Invalid upgrade path

request.description: Marks an active subscription canceled. Status value is `canceled`.

response.name: 422 Already inactive

item.name: Revenue Allocation
item.description: Recognize a period: deduct platform fee (bps), split the pool with Hamilton-Hare, book earning ledger rows. Weights should sum to 1.

request.description: Penny-perfect: platform_cut + instructor shares = period_amount_cents.

response.name: 409 Already distributed
422 Validation failed

request.description: Largest-remainder test: three equal weights leave pennies assigned in remainder order.

item.name: Ledger
item.description: Append-only instructor ledger. Balance is SUM(amount_cents); there is no mutable balance column.

response.name: 200 OK

item.name: Payouts
item.description: Scheduled two-phase payouts (withhold → gateway → settle / fail+adjust / uncertain). Run cycle dispatches queued jobs; with QUEUE_CONNECTION=database run `php artisan queue:work`. Do not POST instructor self-payouts — eligibility is threshold + batch.

request.description: Redis lock `payouts_execution_lock` (7200s). Creates a batch and dispatches ProcessInstructorPayoutJob per instructor.

response.name: 409 Cycle already running

request.description: Queues ReconcileUncertainPayoutsJob (uncertain rows older than 5 minutes).
